comparison.scope: Whole-implementation ratios, not isolated capability overhead. Old code used packed lowering, compact counters and four partitions. All inputs here are full125M on this M1, not mixed10M/M3 timings.

implementation: Generic instruction selection for existing proved query-window regions on little-endian AArch64. Each bounded batch scans eight overlapping starts using four shuffled I64x2 pairs from ordinary I8x16 loads. No new runtime helper, executor, dependency, unsafe block, alphabet assumption or source/name/hash specialization.

Widths1..7 mask the already-hoisted query key; widths8..16 compare first and last eight bytes, whose union covers the exact query. Four independent vector counters reduce after the batch loop. Wider queries gather exact eight-byte prefix matches into an eight-bit mask and compare the existing byte remainder only for its set bits, including dense and overlapping matches.

Every vector load is bounded by the complete actual source extent, and each lane by the legal last window start. The existing actual-owner, ASCII/no-CRLF and region checks remain. Scalar remainders handle short inputs and tails; other architectures/endianness retain the prior scalar lowering. No alignment, notrap or can_move promises are added.

All8 reports retain exactly the preceding work/comparison/visit/transport/carrier counters and original finite global/library limits. One host round, genuine owners, grants, canonical errors and atomic publication remain. No allowance increase/renewal or ABI/IR/work-policy change.
